instruction.text: This isosceles triangle is made up of two right-angled triangles. Find the area of the whole triangle. Give your answer to two decimal places.

atoms.a: First, find the length of 𝘩.
Now, find the area of the whole triangle.

instruction.text: This kite is made up of 3 right-angled triangles. Find the length of 𝘥. Give your answer to two decimal places.

atoms.a: First, find the length of 𝘤.

instruction.text: This circle has a right-angled triangle inside it. Find the circumference of this circle. Give your answer to two decimal places.

atoms.a: First, find the radius of the circle.
Now, find the circumference of the circle.
